content.text: Sean Penn wins his third Oscar, tying the record for most Academy Awards won by a male Video Player is loading.Current Time 0:00Duration 0:00Remaining Time 0:00✕ What do Timothy Chalamet, K-pop, and Paul Thomas Anderson all have in common? They could all be winning their first Oscar at the 98th Academy Awards. I'm Megan Campanova, the entertainment reporter for Hearst Television. Let's break down who could be taking home their first award on movie's biggest night in 2026. Paul Thomas Anderson is no stranger to the Oscars. Throughout his career, he has been nominated for 14 Academymy. Awards for Best Screenplay, Best Director, and Best Picture. However, he's never taken home an award. At the 2026 Academy Awards, he is nominated for Best Director, Best Adapted Screenplay, and Best Picture for his movie One Battle After Another. After winning at all of the precursor awards such as the Golden Globes, the BAFTAs, and the Actor Awards, it can be inferred that Paul Thomas Anderson will be finally. Taking home one of those trophies. Another no stranger to the Oscars is Timothy Chalamet. Just last year, he was nominated for Best Actor, and once again this year, he's nominated for Best Actor. Timothy Chalamet is nominated this year for his role in Marty Supreme, and after losing 3 times in the lead actor race, it seems like Timothy Chalamet might finally be taking home his first Oscar. New to the scene is Jessie Buckley. Jessie Buckley is nominated for her role in Hamlet for Best Lead Actress. After winning at all the festivals, all the precursor awards, it's pretty much Jessie Buckley's award to lose. And finally, K-pop. K-pop Demon Hunters is nominated for Best. Animated feature at the Oscars, and its song Golden from the soundtrack is nominated for Best Original Song. After K-pop Demon Hunters took over the world this year, and its wins at the Grammys and the Golden Globes, it is very likely that K-pop will be joining an elite group of you that have Oscars. Sean Penn wins his third Oscar, tying the record for most Academy Awards won by a male Updated: 5:29 PM PDT Mar 15, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Sean Penn has won his third Oscar at the 98th Academy Awards, tying the record for most Oscars won by a man. Penn won for his role in “One Battle After Another” as Colonel Steven Lockjaw, a militant with a vengeance for a group of revolutionaries. Penn did not attend the ceremony to accept his award.Kieran Culkin, who was presenting the award for Best Supporting Actor, said that "Sean Penn couldn't be here tonight...or didn't want to."Penn has won Best Actor twice before for his performances in “Mystic River” and “Milk.”By winning his third Oscar, Penn joins the company of Jack Nicholson, Daniel Day-Lewis and Walter Brennan as the male actors who have the most Oscars. BUT WE, WE NEED TO BE A Trench rescue training brings together Monterey County agencies Updated: 10:20 AM PDT Mar 26, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Emergency crews from four agencies in Monterey County participated in trench rescue training to prepare for potential trench collapses during sewage or pipeline installations. The training involved the Monterey County Regional Fire District, Cal Fire North Monterey County Fire, and Monterey City Fire, ensuring that all members are trained equitably to operate independently in the field.Josh Terry, captain with the Monterey County Regional Fire District, explained the focus of the training. "So today we're working on specifically, trench collapse. A lot of time in the industry, when you have city workers digging trenches for piping, water, and electrical. They have to dig the holes in the ground in the cities or in those areas. What we're training on is if there were a partial collapse of the actual Earth around them, to how we would shore it up to make it safe for rescuers to get in and save for the victim on the inside and get them safely out," Terry said.He detailed the process, saying, "What we do is we've come in, we set ladders down in initially and do an assessment in that safe area of the trench. So we'll throw in some sheets of plywood or some makeshift saws over the top of them to protect them from any further falling debris. Any vibration in the earth could actually cause a secondary collapse."Terry emphasized the importance of safety during the rescue operations. "So we only put as many people as we need to in the immediate area of the rescue and the rest we, in, cordon off and isolate out of the area to protect everybody," he said.The collaboration among the four agencies allows them to respond effectively to emergencies, even if they arrive at different times. "Our team is made up of four separate agencies. Monterey County Regional Fire District, Cal Fire North Monterey County Fire, and Monterey City Fire. That allows us to go out in the field and operate independently of one another. If any one team shows up first, because we're four separate agencies. We kind of converge to the call, or at separate times. But we, we need to be able to start work. So all the members need to be trained equitably," Terry said.
